content: Lenacapavir, when administered, has the potential to increase the plasma levels or pharmacological effects of various drugs by inhibiting the hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4, which is responsible for the metabolism of many medications. This interaction can lead to an elevated risk of adverse reactions associated with these drugs. The following are specific examples of such interactions: 1. Lapatinib: Lenacapavir increases the levels or effects of lapatinib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and close monitoring are advised. 2. Larotrectinib: Lenacapavir elevates the levels or effects of larotrectinib through CYP3A4 inhibition. Use caution and monitor the patient. 3. Lefamulin: Lenacapavir enhances the levels or effects of lefamulin by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. 4. Levamlodipine: Lenacapavir increases the levels or effects of levamlodipine via CYP3A4 inhibition. Use caution and monitor closely. 5. Levomilnacipran: Lenacapavir raises the levels or effects of levomilnacipran by inhibiting CYP3A4. Caution and monitoring are necessary. 6. Levonorgestrel (intrauterine, oral, transdermal): Lenacapavir increases the levels or effects of levonorgestrel by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. 7. Linagliptin: Lenacapavir elevates the levels or effects of linagliptin through CYP3A4 inhibition. Use caution and monitor. 8. Lomitapide: Lenacapavir enhances the levels or effects of lomitapide by inhibiting CYP3A4. Caution and monitoring are recommended. 9. Loperamide: Lenacapavir increases the levels or effects of loperamide via CYP3A4 inhibition. Use caution and monitor closely. 10. Lopinavir: Lenacapavir raises the levels or effects of lopinavir by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are necessary. 11. Lorlatinib: Lenacapavir enhances the levels or effects of lorlatinib through CYP3A4 inhibition. Use caution and monitor. 12. Losartan: Lenacapavir increases the levels or effects of losartan by inhibiting CYP3A4. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. 13. Lovastatin: Lenacapavir elevates the levels or effects of lovastatin via CYP3A4 inhibition. Initiate lovastatin at the lowest dose and titrate carefully while monitoring for safety, such as signs of myopathy. 14. Lumateperone: Lenacapavir enhances the levels or effects of lumateperone by inhibiting CYP3A4. Do not exceed a lumateperone dose of 21 mg/day when co-administered with lenacapavir. 15. Lumefantrine: Lenacapavir increases the levels or effects of lumefantrine through CYP3A4 inhibition. Use caution and monitor. 16. Lurasidone: Lenacapavir raises the levels or effects of lurasidone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are necessary. 17. Lurbinectedin: Lenacapavir enhances the levels or effects of lurbinectedin via CYP3A4 inhibition. Use caution and monitor. 18. Macimorelin: Lenacapavir increases the levels or effects of macimorelin by inhibiting CYP3A4. Caution and monitoring are recommended. 19. Macitentan: Lenacapavir elevates the levels or effects of macitentan through CYP3A4 inhibition. Use caution and monitor. 20. Maraviroc: Lenacapavir raises the levels or effects of maraviroc by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are necessary. 21. Marijuana: Lenacapavir enhances the levels or effects of marijuana via CYP3A4 inhibition. Use caution and monitor. 22. Mavacamten: Lenacapavir increases the levels or effects of mavacamten by inhibiting CYP3A4. Caution and monitoring are recommended. 23. Mavorixafor: Lenacapavir elevates the levels or effects of mavorixafor through CYP3A4 inhibition. Monitor for adverse effects if co-administered. Additionally, mavorixafor may increase lenacapavir levels via P-glycoprotein inhibition, necessitating caution. 24. Medroxyprogesterone: Lenacapavir raises the levels or effects of medroxyprogesterone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are necessary. 25. Mefloquine: Lenacapavir enhances the levels or effects of mefloquine via CYP3A4 inhibition. Use caution and monitor. 26. Mestranol: Lenacapavir increases the levels or effects of mestranol by inhibiting CYP3A4. Caution and monitoring are recommended. 27. Metaxalone: Lenacapavir elevates the levels or effects of metaxalone through CYP3A4 inhibition. Use caution and monitor. 28. Methadone: Lenacapavir raises the levels or effects of methadone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. When initiating methadone, use the lowest feasible dose and titrate carefully. When starting lenacapavir in patients on methadone, consider dose adjustments for methadone. Monitor clinical signs and symptoms closely. 29. Methylprednisolone: Lenacapavir enhances the levels or effects of methylprednisolone via CYP3A4 inhibition. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. 30. Midazolam (oral, intranasal): Lenacapavir increases the levels or effects of midazolam by inhibiting CYP3A4. Use caution and monitor. 31. Midostaurin: Lenacapavir raises the levels or effects of midostaurin through CYP3A4 inhibition. Caution and monitoring are necessary. 32. Mifepristone: Lenacapavir elevates the levels or effects of mifepristone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 33. Mirtazapine: Lenacapavir enhances the levels or effects of mirtazapine via CYP3A4 inhibition. Caution and monitoring are recommended. 34. Mirvetuximab Soravtansine: Lenacapavir increases the levels or effects of mirvetuximab soravtansine by inhibiting CYP3A4. Use caution and monitor. 35. Mitapivat: Lenacapavir raises the levels or effects of mitapivat through CYP3A4 inhibition. Do not exceed a mitapivat dose of 20 mg BID when co-administered with lenacapavir. 36. Montelukast: Lenacapavir elevates the levels or effects of montelukast by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 37. Naldemedine: Lenacapavir enhances the levels or effects of naldemedine via CYP3A4 inhibition. Caution and monitoring are recommended. 38. Nefazodone: Lenacapavir increases the levels or effects of nefazodone by inhibiting CYP3A4. Use caution and monitor. 39. Nelfinavir: Lenacapavir raises the levels or effects of nelfinavir through CYP3A4 inhibition. Caution and monitoring are necessary. 40. Nifedipine: Lenacapavir elevates the levels or effects of nifedipine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 41. Nilotinib: Lenacapavir enhances the levels or effects of nilotinib via CYP3A4 inhibition. Caution and monitoring are recommended. 42. Nirmatrelvir/Ritonavir: Lenacapavir increases the levels or effects of nirmatrelvir/ritonavir by inhibiting CYP3A4. Use caution and monitor. In all cases, lenacapavir's inhibition of CYP3A4 can lead to significant drug interactions, necessitating careful dose adjustments, close monitoring, and consideration of alternative therapies to mitigate the risk of adverse effects.
